notes: MOTHER: BEST (UNCONFIRMED) CANDIDATE (research 2026-07-04, re: Martha Taber Hedger's parent-too-young flag): unlike her tree-listed siblings William, Thomas, and Mary Ann -- all now reattributed away from Martha (see I182195863486.json manual.notes) -- Margaret's Jan 1764 birth is chronologically COMPATIBLE with Martha (b.1720, so ~44 at this birth) and postdates the 1759 death of Peter's documented second wife, Ann Hanna Ellis. Peter's 1786 will (per the Albert Stirling Adams 'Cheesman Family' manuscript) bequeaths 10 pounds to 'Margaret(4) Pierce, wife of William Pierce,' matching this Margaret, but does not name her mother -- so the Martha attribution remains plausible but unconfirmed by any source found. Full writeup: docs/research/ancestors/gen09-martha-taber-hedger-eliza-bolton-taber.md.
